subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar funções do texto dramático (escrito para ser encenado) e sua organização por meio de diálogos entre personagens e marcadores das falas das personagens e de cena.

components.description_pt: Identificar textos dramáticos como escritos especificamente para serem encenados
components.description_en: Identify dramatic texts as written specifically to be performed
components.cc_component_description: Contrast the techniques used in written and performed versions of a story, drama, or poem

components.description_pt: Reconhecer diálogos entre personagens como estrutura organizacional primária de textos dramáticos
components.description_en: Recognize dialogue between characters as the primary organizational structure of dramatic texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural features of dramatic forms such as soliloquy and their function

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos estruturais do drama como diálogo, indicações cênicas e elenco
components.description_en: Identify structural elements of drama such as dialogue, stage directions, and cast of characters
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of drama such as dialogue, stage directions, and cast of characters

cc_matches.description: Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
Analyze how a drama's or poem's form or structure (e.g., soliloquy, sonnet) contributes to its meaning.

Compare and contrast the experience of reading a story, drama, or poem to listening to or viewing an audio, video, or live version of the text, including contrasting what they "see" and "hear" when reading the text to what they perceive when they listen or watch.
